I'm considering how to search files when I don't have a git repository available. While I could potentially use `git grep`, it isn't applicable here. Instead, I want to use `awk` combined with recursive shell globs to search through limited directories. So, I might be thinking along the lines of using `shopt -s globstar` in bash and a loop to apply `awk` to each `.go` file found. It's all about finding the right command!
